## Summary
A concise description of the proposed skill or enhancement.

## Motivation & Use Case
Why is this skill needed? Which programming language, framework, or workflow does it support?

## Proposed Principles & Content
Outline the core rules, decision criteria, or reference files that this skill should include.

## Prior Art & Sources
Link to any reference repositories, design systems, or documentation that inspire this skill.
